items.title: Companies Are Spending 5x More on AI Now

Budgets built for seats are colliding with a per-token reality.

items.title: Anthropic buys $3.4bn of gas generators for its data centres, FT reports
items.summary:
Anthropic has agreed to pay $3.4bn for gas-fired generators to power its data centres, the Financial Times reported on Sunday. items.title: Italy blames pro-Russian hackers for leaking Tajani’s personal data
items.summary:

items.title: UK may add Vinted and eBay to its under-16 social media ban
items.summary:
